relations.subject: Frederic Henry Gravely
relations.evidence: Frederic Henry Gravely, collaborated with Ramachandran on the scientific basis for identifying the period of metal images between 1925-1935.

relations.subject: Tiruvengadu Narayanayajwa Ramachandran
relations.evidence: Ramachandran and Y.D. Sharma visited Afghanistan between May and July 1956, in order to explore and investigate the art traditions, epigraphical records, and archaeological remains.
